note: Authoritative, machine-readable support matrix. A cell is 'tested' ONLY where a real test or drill exercised that surface on that platform. The guard (TestSupportMatrixOnlyClaimsWhatIsProven, tests/docs/) resolves every proof id and FAILS a 'tested' or 'build-only' cell whose proof does not exist, a cell that claims nothing while citing proof, and any (surface, platform) pair the matrix forgot. support-matrix.md is rendered from this file and is checked cell-by-cell against it.
platform_axis: For a SERVER surface the platform is the CONTAINER platform, not the operator's laptop: Docker Desktop on an arm64 Mac runs linux/arm64 containers, so an arm64 Mac exercises the linux/arm64 column. Palai's services ship only as linux images, so darwin/* is not-applicable for every server surface. For the CLI the platform is the workstation.

levels.tested: A real test or drill ran this surface on this platform. The proof ids say which.
levels.build-only: The artifact is built, digest-indexed and verified for this platform, but the topology it enables was not exercised there.
levels.not-tested: Neither. Not claimed, not forbidden — nobody has run it.
levels.not-applicable: The surface does not exist on this platform by construction.

cells.note: Built by the buildx matrix and boot-smoked under emulation. A boot-smoke is NOT a UAT run (E18 §6 leg 3).
Every runbook transcript in docs/operations/runbooks/transcripts was recorded here.
The E14 self-host journey: clean install, CA-verified TLS edge, admin provisioning through the edge, a real provider run, backup and restore into a separate clean stack.
On a kind cluster. kindnet does NOT enforce NetworkPolicy, so default-deny is proven as a RENDER, not as enforcement — a real enforcing CNI is E15 §6 leg 1.
Offline verify plus tamper rejection on an internal Docker network. A physical air-gapped facility with an operator trust-root ceremony is E15 §6 leg 2.
The package is built per-arch and signature-verified, and mTLS enrollment is proven over the compose network (LP-007) — but on the SAME host. A separate physical host with systemd is E14 §6 leg 3.
Every CLI command in the runbooks was executed here.

elsewhere.sdks: docs/operations/sdk-compatibility.md (+ .json) — SDK × capability, its own honest-matrix guard.
elsewhere.managed-cloud: Not offered. There is no managed cell and no microVM isolation tier; see docs/security/threat-model.md.
elsewhere.windows: No Windows support of any kind is claimed — the CLI is not built for it and nothing has been run there.
